explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because .format(data) embeds user input directly inside single quotes in the INSERT statement. Crafted input in data could break out of the string literal and execute arbitrary SQL commands. The repair replaces interpolation with a %s placeholder, but passes bare data instead of a 1-tuple (data,) to cursor.execute(), causing a DB-API parameter-binding error for strings.
